title: Ideas and biases are random because neurons do not know what to build

statements.text: New ideas and biases are random or pseudorandom because neurons, like DNA, do not know what would be useful. Random changes searched by evolution are certain to give good ideas sometimes, while bad ones are forgotten or kept as knowledge of what not to do.

sources.quote: Because our neurons are not clever and have no idea what they should build
bad ideas can be forgotten or saved as knowledge about what not to do.
